sources.name: Stored Google Maps competitor snapshot
sources.role: Supply, rating and review-volume demand proxy

score_formula.demand: 45% Arizona Google Trends + 35% reviews per listing + 20% Tucson/DMA search share; missing search layers use a neutral value and reduce confidence
score_formula.corridor_gap: 70% corridor demand evidence + 30% category white space

caveats: Google Trends is a relative index, not absolute search volume.
Review volume is a demand proxy, not audited revenue or verified foot traffic.
Traffic figures are published peak-period intersection proxies and do not cover every corridor.
A high score identifies what to test first; it does not prove that a store will succeed.
